business_and_profit_drivers: Embedded-security products remain the dominant revenue source and are exposed to bank/social-security-card replacement demand, product pricing and secure-element input economics.
Intelligent hardware and software/service revenue are smaller diversification legs but have not offset the decline in the core embedded-security franchise.
eSIM, SuperSIM and related secure-connectivity products are optional growth vectors whose economic contribution depends on converting certifications and supplier qualifications into scaled shipments.
Digital-RMB products and solutions create thematic optionality, but company disclosure states related revenue remained below 5% of revenue as of the latest warning.
Working-capital conversion and gross-margin recovery are essential because recent revenue decline has been accompanied by losses and negative operating cash flow.

capital_comparison.judgment: At the latest completed-session price, expected return is deeply negative and materially inferior to cash plus the current positive-expected-return decision-grade opportunity set.

thesis.core: The current share-price recovery is not yet an operating recovery. Core embedded-security economics weakened into 2026H1, losses widened and cash conversion remained negative, while the digital-RMB theme that drove recent attention was disclosed as less than 5% of revenue.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use RMB40m/RMB100m/RMB180m normalized attributable profit for bear/base/bull plus a RMB400m haircut liquid-asset cushion. The base case already assumes earnings above 2023; the bull case restores earnings to slightly above the 2022 peak.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market is capitalizing digital-RMB/eSIM optionality and a fast price recovery as if a major earnings recovery is imminent. Primary disclosures instead show declining revenue, wider losses and weak cash conversion, so the investment case fails before momentum is treated as evidence.

catalysts: Embedded-security pricing and gross margin recover on sustained bank/social-security-card replacement demand.
eSIM certifications convert into material commercial shipments with positive gross-margin contribution.
Digital-RMB related revenue becomes economically material rather than remaining below 5% of company revenue.
Deducted net profit turns sustainably positive and operating cash flow improves without further inventory or receivable absorption.
kill_thesis: Embedded-security revenue or gross margin remains under pressure and no durable core-volume/price recovery is visible.
Digital-RMB/eSIM theme activity fails to convert into material revenue and cash earnings.
Deducted earnings remain negative or weak while working capital continues to absorb cash.
Valuation continues to require sustainable profit materially above the company's 2022 historical peak before primary evidence supports such an earnings step-up.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base assumes a recovery above 2023 earnings; bull already restores earnings to slightly above the 2022 historical peak. H1 2026 losses are not annualized, and only a haircut liquid-asset cushion is credited because working-capital needs remain material.
